document.cue: Describe a piece of technology that you use every day.

text: I'm going to talk about my laptop, which I use every single day. I bought it about two years ago, when I started university, and my parents helped me to pay for it. It's a fairly light silver laptop, so it's easy to carry around in my bag.

I use it for almost everything. In the morning I check my emails and the news, and during the day I write assignments, make presentations and join online classes. In the evening I sometimes watch series or chat with friends, so I probably spend around six or seven hours a day on it. What I like is that it has a very good battery, which means I can work in a café or in the library without looking for a socket. I also keep all my documents and photos on it, so it's like a small office and a photo album in one.

It's useful to me mainly because it saves time. For example, I can find information in a few seconds, whereas in the past students had to spend hours in the library. Having said that, I try not to depend on it too much, because sometimes I spend too long online and don't get things done. Anyway, I can't imagine my studies without it, so it's definitely one of the most important things I own.

tips.en: Whereas contrasts today with the past in one sentence.
tips.kk: Whereas бүгінгі күн мен өткенді бір сөйлемде салыстырады.
tips.ru: Whereas сравнивает сегодняшний день с прошлым в одном предложении.
tips.example: whereas in the past students had to spend hours in the library

tips.en: Having said that and Anyway sound natural and signal a change of thought.
tips.kk: Having said that және Anyway табиғи естіледі, ойды ауыстыруға көмектеседі.
tips.ru: Having said that и Anyway звучат естественно и помогают смене мысли.
tips.example: Having said that, I try not to depend on it too much

phrases.text: I can't imagine my studies without it

note.en: Names the object, when it was bought and what it looks like.
note.kk: Затты, қашан алынғанын және қандай көрінетінін атайды.
note.ru: Называет предмет, когда он появился и как выглядит.

note.en: Shows in detail how it is used through the day.
note.kk: Заттың күн бойы қалай қолданылатынын егжей-тегжейлі көрсетеді.
note.ru: Подробно показывает, как предмет используется в течение дня.

note.en: Explains why it matters and adds an honest reservation.
note.kk: Заттың маңызын түсіндіріп, шынайы ескертпе қосады.
note.ru: Объясняет значимость предмета и добавляет честную оговорку.

document.title: Technology you use every day
bullets: and explain why it is important to you.
